description: Test implementation of a mock plugin API for Mattermost, including methods for key-value operations, error simulation, and logging.

classes.name: mockPluginAPI
classes.description: A mock implementation of a plugin API for testing purposes, simulating key-value store operations with error injection.

methods.name: newMockPluginAPI
methods.description: Creates a new instance of mockPluginAPI with initialized key-value store.

methods.name: setFailing
methods.description: Sets the failing state to simulate errors in API operations.

methods.name: setFailingWithPrefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix for which operations will simulate errors.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all key-value pairs from the mock store.

methods.name: KVGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key, possibly returning an error if in failing state.

methods.name: KVDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair, possibly returning an error if in failing state.

methods.name: KVList
methods.description: Lists keys with pagination, possibly returning an error if in failing state.

methods.name: KVSetWithOptions
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with options, supporting atomic operations and error simulation.

methods.name: LogError
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional key-value pairs.
